primary_constraint: Dribbling delay (~2.5s bounce cycle) eliminates traditional dribble drives; requires multi-tier 6-8m rims; cutting is limited by low downward normal force.
adaptation: Pass-heavy motion offenses, elevated rim assemblies, micro-spike court footwear.

primary_constraint: Aerodynamic lift dominates ballistics; routine clearance kicks stall and drift like balloons; dome pressurization volume becomes massive.
adaptation: Weighted low-rebound balls, perimeter net containment, gliding suit goalkeeping.

primary_constraint: Linear momentum (p = mv) remains standard while surface grip plummets; tackles retain full bone-breaking impact force with minimal stopping friction.
adaptation: 200m field lengths, reinforced safety run-off zones, mandatory deceleration harnesses.

primary_constraint: Apparent weight varies by skating vector (skating with the spin increases blade bite, skating against it induces hydroplaning); airborne pucks veer laterally.
adaptation: Spin-aligned rink layout, calibrated curvature trajectory markers on arena glass.

primary_constraint: Exit velocities never drop; an unanchored batter striking a 90 mph pitch recoils into an uncontrolled spin via Newton's third law.
adaptation: Magnetic boot locking plates, concentric sensor scoring rings replacing base paths, soft high-drag core balls.

primary_constraint: Spin gravity weakens with height, so a jump shot rises into progressively lighter apparent weight; Coriolis deflection curves the ball several centimetres sideways before it reaches the rim, and the curve reverses depending on which way down the ring you shoot.
adaptation: Courts laid perpendicular to the spin axis to equalise both baskets, backboards offset to the calculated drift, mandatory drift-calibration for visiting teams.

primary_constraint: The ball never returns to a surface, so the pitch becomes a volume and possession becomes a momentum budget; a player who strikes the ball hard has spent their only means of changing course until they reach a wall.
adaptation: Spherical goal shells at opposing poles, tethered launch handholds ringing the hull, high-drag foam balls that bleed velocity into the cabin air.

primary_constraint: A drive running with the rotation gains apparent weight and traction; the same drive running against it lightens the players and loosens their footing, so identical plays gain different yardage depending on field orientation.
adaptation: Fields laid along the spin axis to null the asymmetry, deep passing charted against curvature tables, end zones swapped every quarter.

primary_constraint: Ice is the native ground, but at an eighth of a g the blade cannot bite: edge work, crossovers and stopping all fail together, and a routine check sends both players tumbling with no weight to arrest them.
adaptation: Ballasted skate assemblies, powered edge-grip blades, boards enclosing all six surfaces of the rink volume.

primary_constraint: Fly balls die: apex and carry fall to a little over half of Earth's, collapsing the outfield game, while every sprint, slide and landing runs through knees and shoulders at nearly twice normal weight.
adaptation: Shortened base paths and outfield fences, low-mass composite bats, enforced pitch counts and innings caps written around joint loading.
